IVD MTD.name: IVD MTD
IVD MTD.definition:
measure 'IVD MTD' =
			
			CALCULATE(
			   [IVD],
			    '0_0_CALENDARIO'[M0] = TRUE())
		displayFolder: _IVD
		lineageTag: c55bd88d-fa91-473a-b6cb-10b2f2f617e1

		formatStringDefinition =
				var vvalor = SELECTEDMEASURE()
				var vAjuste =
				    """" &
				    SWITCH(
				        TRUE(),
				        vvalor >= 1000000000, FORMAT(divide(vvalor,1000000000), "R$ #.##,B"),
				        vvalor >= 1000000,    FORMAT(divide(vvalor,1000000), "R$ #.##M"),
				        vvalor >= 1000,       FORMAT(divide(vvalor,1000), "R$ #.##K"),
				                              FORMAT(vvalor, "R$ #,0")
				    )
				    & """"
				return
				vAjuste

IVD.name: IVD
IVD.definition:
measure IVD =
			
			
			CALCULATE(
			    SUM(FATOS_PARTICULAR_TVD_IVD[IVD_SIMPLIFICADO]),
			
			    LASTNONBLANK(
			        '0_0_CALENDARIO'[Data],
			        CALCULATE(
			            SUM(FATOS_PARTICULAR_TVD_IVD[IVD_SIMPLIFICADO])
			        )
			    ),
			
			    ALL(AP_CONVERSAO),
			
			    FILTER(
			        DIM_LOCAL,
			        NOT DIM_LOCAL[TIPO_LOCAL]
			            IN {"DEPÓSITO", "CD", "LOJA VIRTUAL"}
			    ),
			
			    FILTER(
			        DIM_CATALOGO_LOCAL,
			        NOT DIM_CATALOGO_LOCAL[Tipo local]
			            IN {"DEPÓSITO", "CD", "LOJA VIRTUAL"}
			    )
			)
		displayFolder: _IVD
		lineageTag: 17c35dc9-8b1f-4fe4-9e04-935ff6b0d498

		formatStringDefinition =
				var vValor = SELECTEDMEASURE()
				var Unidade = SELECTEDVALUE(AP_CONVERSAO[nm_measure])
				
				var vAjuste =
				    """" &
				    SWITCH(
				        TRUE(),
				        ABS(vValor) >= 1000000000,
				            "R$ " & FORMAT(vValor, "#,0,,,.00B"),
				
				        ABS(vValor) >= 1000000,
				            "R$ " & FORMAT(vValor, "#,0,,.00M"),
				
				        ABS(vValor) >= 1000,
				            "R$ " & FORMAT(vValor, "#,0,.00K"),
				            "R$ " & FORMAT(vValor, "#,0.00; -#,0.00; 0.00")
				    )
				    & """"
				
				return
				    vAjuste
